How QualiTime works

Four inputs. One clear timeline.

Open the tool in your browser — no install, no login — enter your study parameters, and get a phased Gantt chart in seconds.

1

Enter your key informant interview parameters

Number of key informant interviews, average interview length, transcription approach (auto vs. manual), and your coding method (inductive, deductive, or thematic).

2

Add focus group parameters (if applicable)

Number of focus groups, group size, and session length. The tool calculates focus group timelines separately from individual interviews.

3

Set your reporting context

Report type, length, and whether you're writing solo or with a team. This shapes the write-up phase calculation.

4

Get your Gantt chart

QualiTime outputs a color-coded, phased timeline you can screenshot, paste into a SOW, or walk a client through directly.

Common questions

FAQ

Do I need to install anything? ›

No. QualiTime runs entirely in your web browser — no downloads, no accounts, no plugins. Open the link, enter your parameters, get your timeline.

What types of qualitative studies does it support? ›

QualiTime is built for key informant interview and focus group studies, with separate parameter sets for each. It handles deductive, inductive, and thematic coding approaches, and supports both auto and manual transcription. It's been validated against rapid assessments, formative research, program evaluations, and dissertation studies.

How accurate are the timeline estimates? ›

QualiTime uses evidence-informed parameters — research on transcription rates, coding time per interview, and typical reporting cycles — rather than arbitrary guesses. It won't account for every project-specific variable, but it gives you a defensible baseline grounded in how qualitative work actually unfolds.

What's the difference between the Practitioner and Team licenses? ›

The Practitioner license is for a single user. The Team license covers up to 10 users and includes the Team Onboarding Guide — a 1-pager for introducing QualiTime in a group SOW discussion — plus suggested parameters for common project types and a facilitation script for group sessions.

Can I use this in a client proposal or SOW? ›

Yes. The Gantt chart output is designed to be shared — screenshot it, embed it in a Word or PDF document, or walk through it on screen with a client. Both licenses permit commercial use.

Is this a subscription? ›

No. Both licenses are one-time purchases. You pay once and keep access to the tool and all included materials.
